notes: Napoleon documentary, chapter 3 (Italy, Egypt and Power): 7 paintings x 4 seeds, 16:9, style ghm_painterly_v2. Client picks; nothing is final before approval.

shots.framing: wide shot along a stony mountain road, a long column of ragged soldiers marching from the right toward the left into Alpine foothills
shots.scene: the French Army of Italy, spring 1796, threadbare mismatched uniforms, some soldiers without shoes, mules with supplies, Ligurian mountains and the sea far below
shots.lighting: hard bright spring sun, deep blue sky, dust in the air

shots.framing: dynamic medium-wide shot, the young general on a narrow causeway on the left third carrying a tricolour flag forward, soldiers around him, a wooden bridge ahead in smoke
shots.scene: the Battle of Arcole, November 1796, the causeway through the marshes by the Alpone, long hair, general's blue coat with gold embroidery and a tricolour sash, Austrian musket fire from across the bridge
shots.lighting: pale November light, smoke backlit by muzzle flashes
shots.negative_extra: text, letters, watermark, close-up wounds, blood, gore

shots.framing: medium-wide interior, the young French general standing at a table on the left third, pointing at a map, two Austrian envoys in white uniforms seated opposite
shots.scene: peace negotiations with Austria, 1797, a villa room with painted ceilings, documents and quills on the table, French officers behind
shots.lighting: warm daylight from tall windows, dust in the light

shots.framing: epic wide desert panorama, a French infantry square firing on the left, a charge of Mamluk horsemen in bright silks sweeping from the right, pyramids on the far horizon
shots.scene: the Battle of the Pyramids, 21 July 1798, French infantry in blue coats and bicornes, Mamluk cavalry with curved swords, the Nile and palms in the midground
shots.lighting: harsh golden afternoon desert sun, heat haze, dust and smoke
shots.negative_extra: text, letters, watermark, close-up wounds, blood, gore

shots.framing: wide night seascape, a huge three-decker warship exploding in the centre, other ships of the line in silhouette around it, burning debris on the water
shots.scene: the Battle of the Nile at Aboukir Bay, 1 August 1798, the French flagship L'Orient blowing up, British ships closing in
shots.lighting: night, blinding orange explosion lighting the smoke and the sea, deep blue darkness around

shots.framing: wide interior of a crowded hall, grenadiers with fixed bayonets entering from the left, deputies in red togas and caps rising in confusion on the right, a young general in the centre
shots.scene: the coup of 18-19 Brumaire, 10 November 1799, the Council of Five Hundred in the Orangery of the chateau of Saint-Cloud
shots.lighting: grey November daylight through tall windows, tense shadows

shots.framing: wide mountain view, a long column of soldiers hauling cannon barrels in hollowed tree trunks up a snowy pass from the right foreground toward the left, rock walls and peaks
shots.scene: the French Army of Reserve crossing the Great Saint Bernard Pass, May 1800, the hospice in the distance, mules and sledges, men pulling ropes
shots.lighting: bright cold alpine light, blue shadows on the snow
